results.title: Babar Azam down with high fever amid PCB fiasco ahead of 3rd Test vs England
results.description: Adding to an already chaotic situation within the touring contingent, Pakistan captain Babar Azam has fallen ill with a high fever as the squad prepares for the third Test against England at Edgbaston.

results.title: Wallabies back Kiss as Australia chase fifth straight win
results.description: MENDOZA: New Australia coach Les Kiss has got the seal of approval from his players as the Wallabies look to extend their winning streak to five matches when they take on Argentina in the second test in Mendoza on Saturday.
